title: Everleigh's Rocky Top Reef voice cast
note: Bake every file below. The app never uses browser read-aloud. Existing Sunny Candy clips and mom clips stay and keep these filenames. A missing file shows the caption only.

characters.role: unicorn fish, host and letter sounds
characters.personality: Warm, slow, playful. Celebrates effort. Never grades.
characters.voice: Candy, already baked where a file exists

lines.text: Hi, Everleigh. I am Sunny. Want to light the Crystal Path, or practice a reef game?
Hi, Everleigh. The reef is open. Light the Crystal Path, practice a game, or swim an Explorer Check.
Hi, Everleigh. Explorer Check is a swim, not a test. Finish a lagoon and a gem appears. No grades.
These games open after your reef swim. The swim is ready whenever you are.
Which sound does this letter make?
You finished the swim. A gem for completing the adventure. Sunny did not keep a score.
Resting is a strong choice. The gem waits until this adventure chunk is finished.
The swim is finished. New games are ready, right where you are.
Ooh, that one tricked me too — let’s sneak up on it.
Let’s float to a cozier current. I’ll hum a hint.
A deeper current is opening. We can swim it together.
The path opened a wider lagoon. Let’s peek together.
I like how you tried that!
Let’s visit letter friends in the lagoon.

characters.personality: Bubbly and patient. Listens for rhymes and sounds.

lines.text: I’m Bubbles. Let’s listen for sounds, nice and slow.
Which word rhymes with this one?
How many sounds are in this word?
Let’s listen for the first sound, nice and slow.

characters.role: seahorse, CVC words and memory words
characters.personality: Bright and quick, still kind. Stretches sounds into words.

lines.text: I’m Zippy. Stretch the little word, then wave at the memory word.
Tap the same word. No rush.
These little words are swimming by. Let’s blend them.
Some words we remember by sight. No rush.

characters.personality: Slow, steady, counts one pearl at a time.

lines.text: I’m Shelly. Count slowly with me.
How many pearls do you see?
Count the pearls with me, one shell at a time.

characters.personality: Snappy but gentle. Tells tiny fish stories.

lines.text: I’m Coco. A fish story. Some join, some swim away.
Fish swim. More join. How many now?
Fish swim. Some swim away. How many stay?
A tiny fish story. We can use the fish to help.

characters.personality: Warm, proud of effort, never a score.
characters.voice: Existing mom clips stay. Intended later bake: Teri when a plan allows it.

lines.text: I'm so proud of how hard you tried today. That brave effort matters.
Welcome back. I'm glad we can look at the reef together.
